# Akirma Events PLC

> Ethiopia's leading event planning and management company, based on Bole Road in Addis Ababa. Full-service weddings, corporate conferences, government ceremonies, cultural and religious celebrations, concerts, decoration, sound & light, stage & tent rental, catering and furniture supply. 500+ events delivered across Ethiopia — from intimate weddings to 20,000-guest government ceremonies. 7+ years of excellence. Bilingual team (English / Amharic).

## Services

1. Wedding Planning — traditional and modern Ethiopian weddings tailored to your dreams.
2. Corporate Events — professional conferences, product launches, and business meetings.
3. Cultural & Religious Events — Timket, Meskel, holidays, and large-scale church gatherings.
4. Concerts & Festivals — full-scale stage, sound, and crowd management for major events.
5. Decoration & Setup — breathtaking venue design, lighting, and cultural aesthetics.
6. Advert & Promotion — strategic marketing campaigns and promotional materials for your events.
7. Event Organization — complete end-to-end event planning and coordination services.
8. Stage & Tent Rental — professional stage setups and high-quality tent rentals.
9. Sound & Light Supply — state-of-the-art audio and lighting equipment for any event size.
10. Chair & Table Supply — elegant furniture rentals to accommodate all your guests.
11. Catering Supply — delicious catering services with traditional and modern cuisine.
12. Kids Game Material Supply — fun and safe entertainment equipment for children at your events.

## Frequently asked

- How far in advance should I book? For major weddings and large conferences, book at least 15–30 days in advance; smaller corporate events can often be arranged within 15–30 days.
- Do you work outside Addis Ababa? Yes — destination weddings and corporate retreats across Ethiopia, including Lalibela, Bahir Dar, and Hawassa.
- Payment structure: 30% deposit to secure the date, 40% midway through planning, and the final 30% one week before the event.
